operations.description: The address parser and address standardizer, are part of the Gisgraphy project (free open source worldwide geocoder). Address parsing is the process of dividing a single address string into its individual component parts. Please visit [http://www.address-parser.net](http://www.address-parser.net) for more details
operations.summary: split a raw address into several parts
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] addressparsing [PATH] addressparser parse [PARAMS] address callback country format geocode indent standardize [SCHEMA] address dto results

operations.description: The full text service allows you to search for features / places / street and do autocompletion . you can : Specify one or more words search on part of the name (auto completion / suggestion) Search for text or zip code Specify a GPS restriction (promote nearest, not sorted but has an impact on the score), Limit the results to a specific Language, Country, place type, Paginate the results, Specify the output verbosity, Tells if you want the output to be indented, Tells that all words are required or not, The search is case insensitive, use synonyms (Saint/st, ..), separator characters stripping, ...
operations.summary: search for places by text around a GPS point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fulltxtsearch [PATH] fulltext search [PARAMS] allwordsrequired callback country format from indent lang lat lng q radius spellchecking style suggest to [SCHEMA] dto fulltext house number response results solr

operations.description: The Gisgraphy geocoding service allows you to transform postal addresses or other descriptions (a street, a city, a postal code, a country, or a combination) of a location into a (latitude, longitude) coordinate.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] geocode [PATH] geocoding geocode [PARAMS] address callback country format from indent postal to [SCHEMA] address dto results

operations.description: The geolocalisation service allows to search for features around a earth location. you can Specify GPS position, Limit the results to a specific place type (e.g : search all monuments around a point), Limit the results to a specified radius, Paginate the results, Tells if you want the output to be indented (currently, applies only for XML, not JSON for performance reasons. May change in next version)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] geoloc [PATH] geoloc search [PARAMS] callback distance format from indent lat lng placetype radius to [SCHEMA] distance dto feature geoloc gis results

operations.description: The Reverse geocoding service allows to search for an address for a given GPS position.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reversegeocode [PATH] reversegeocoding reversegeocode [PARAMS] callback format from indent lat lng to [SCHEMA] address dto results

operations.description: The street service allows you to search for street by GPS position. You can : Specify GPS position, Give the beginning or a part of the name of the street (useful for autocompletion), Limit search to a specific type (e.g : Pedestrian, highway, residential, ... 25 types available), Limit search to a specified radius, Limit search to one way streets,
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] streetsearch [PATH] street find [PARAMS] callback distance format from indent lat lng oneway radius streettype to [SCHEMA] distance dto results search street
